description: This file defines API routes for a journal tracking backend using FastAPI. It includes endpoints to submit a journal entry for today, fetch the current streak, retrieve journal history, and get entries by date. The routes depend on database session management and service functions for core logic.

classes.name: JournalEntryOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for journal entry output data.

classes.name: JournalHistoryOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for listing journal history.

classes.name: StreakOut
classes.description: Pydantic model representing user's streak status.

methods.name: JournalEntryOut submit_today_entry(payload: JournalEntryCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Endpoint to submit today's journal entry for a user.

methods.name: StreakOut get_current_streak( user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier."), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve user's current streak count.

methods.name: JournalHistoryOut get_history( user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier."), limit: int = Query(365, ge=1, le=5000, description="Maximum entries to return."), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list journal entries for a user.

methods.name: Optional[JournalEntryOut] get_entry( user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier."), entry_date: date = Query(..., description="Entry date (YYYY-MM-DD)."), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Endpoint to get a journal entry for a specific date.
